name: [FREE GUARD] Red Light, Green Light: Unlimited
desc:
Welcome to Red Light, Green Light: Unlimited ♾️!

Here you can either choose to participate in the deadly game as a contestant, or be an enforcer of the rules as a guard!

*Premium Users get to bypass the Manager team kill and win requirements!*

Rules for players:
Run if its Green Light
Stop if its Red Light (or else!)
Make it to the finish line "unharmed"

Rules for Guards:
Shoot whoever is marked red
Do NOT miss!

Tips for Guards:
There is a workbench behind each door in the guard room, it allows you to customize you sniper!
If you scroll while aiming you can adjust your aim sensitivity!

Like and favorite the game to get notified of further updates, and don't forget to join the group if you wanna add feedback!
